I could not complete this calculation reliably, so I am not returning a full diagram.

Working it out by hand requires diagonalising the octahedral d⁴ energy matrices (7×7 for ³T₁g, 5×5 for ³T₂g, plus the singlet blocks) at each of the nine Dq/B values. I have no code-execution tool here, and I did not get the Racah-parameter term energies at Dq/B = 0 to a verified result. No plot was saved.

What is established:
- Free-ion terms of d⁴ are ⁵D; ³H, ³G, ³F×2, ³D, ³P×2; ¹I, ¹G×2, ¹F, ¹D×2, ¹S×2 (dimensions sum to 210).
- Octahedral quintets are ⁵E_g and ⁵T₂g only. Relative to ⁵E_g, ⁵T₂g lies at 10Dq, so E/B = 10·(Dq/B). This is exact at every grid point, but ⁵E_g is the ground level only while no triplet lies below it. At larger Dq a triplet (³T₁g) drops below, so these entries are not the lowest six levels there.

The structured output below gives only the quintet levels at each grid point. It is not a complete answer: the remaining levels at each point need the triplet and singlet matrix diagonalisation, which I have not done.
